arabic text: ZAHRA TUJHE DARBBAAR MEIN HAQ KYUN NAA MILA HAIN?
english translation text: O BIBI ZAHRA (AS), WHY THEY DID NOT GIVE YOUR RIGHT IN THE DARBAAR?

arabic text: SHAAYAD KE YAHI AJRE RISAALAT KA SILA HAIN
english translation text: PERHAPS THIS MIGHT BE THE PAYBACK TO RASOOL BY THE UMMAH!!

arabic text: MEHROOM RAHI HAQ SAY TU UMMAT KI SADAAYI JHUTLAAI SHARIFOON NAI TERI PAAK GAWAHI
english translation text: O BIBI ZAHRA (AS), YOUR RIGHT WAS NOT GIVEN TO YOU. EVEN YOUR PROVIDED WITNESSES WERE IGNORED BY KHALIFAH

arabic text: ISS GHAM NAI TERE DIL KA SUKOON CHINLIA HAI
english translation text: THAT WAS THE REASON YOU WERE IN EXTREME MOURNING

arabic text: EHSAAN FARAAMOSHON NAI HAI TUJH KO RULAAYA OR BAADE NABI KYUN HAI SAQIFE MEIN BULAAYA
english translation text: FOLLOWERS OF WRONGFUL LEFT YOU CRY AND CRY. THOSE FOLLOWERS, THEN ORGANIZED SAQEEFA

arabic text: 1400 BARAS SE HAME YEHI TO GILAA HAIN
english translation text: THIS IS THE COMPLAIN WE ARE HAVING FOR LAST 1400 YEARS

arabic text: DARWAAZA TERE PEHLU PE ZAALIM NE GIRAAYA
english translation text: THOSE WRONG DOERS THREW BURNING DOOR ON YOUR BODY

arabic text: KYUN BINTE MUHAMMAD PE USE REHEM NA AAYA KIS JURM MEIN ZAALIM NE TUJHE ZAKHM DIYA HAI
english translation text: THEY DID NOT BOTHER OBSERVE YOUR HIGHNESS. WHY THEY DID CRUELTY ON YOU?

arabic text: MAATAM TERI AULAAD KA DIN RAAT KARENGE PARTE HAIN AGAR KALMA TO HAQ BAAT KARENGE
english translation text: WE WILL KEEP MOURNING ON YOU AND YOUR FAMILY. WE MUST KEEP MOURNING LIKE WE SAY KALIMA

arabic text: JANNAT TERI AULAAD KO RONE KA SILA HAI
english translation text: HEAVENS IS JUST A MINOR REWARD TO CRY ON YOUR FAMILY

arabic text: FARMAANE RISAALAT KO JO BHULAY VO ZAALIM
english translation text: ALL WHO IGNORED THE PROPHET’S ADVICE ABOUT GHADEER

arabic text: BESHAK WO NAMAAZI HAIN YA DEEN KE AALIM UNKE LIYE SARDAAR JAHANNAM KI SAZA HAI
english translation text: AMONG THEM MIGHT BE NAMAAZEE OR SCHOLARS BUT THEY WILL GET HIGHEST AND PAINFUL PUNISHMENT ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT
